narrative.overview:
White paper, black structure and yellow emphasis make the marketing site and documentation feel like one readable manual. This is the user-selected Dozer reference as implemented for Shady Notes: plain controls, framed product evidence and generous reading space. It replaces the earlier green terminal treatment on web surfaces.

This file governs `site/` and `docs-site/`. Native macOS imagery, existing brand films and slide decks retain their own visual authority in `brand/brand-brief.md`; their genuine colours are product evidence, not web chrome. The umbrella remains the actual artwork beside the two-word name.
keyCharacteristics: White ground and black text, borders and focus rings.
Yellow fills and pale yellow reading highlights.
Sans reading and controls; mono code, paths and pricing data.
Rounded framed panels and pill controls.
Real app imagery, shared navigation and shared footer language.

rules.name: The Yellow Fill Rule
rules.body: Yellow is a fill or highlight with black text; reading links remain black and underlined.

rules.name: The Evidence Colour Rule
rules.body: Product screenshots, app theme samples and existing films keep their authentic colours; the surrounding web controls use the web palette.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Docs article width is 70ch; summaries and prose excerpts stay within 60–65ch where their components establish that limit.

rules.name: The State Before Lift Rule
rules.body: Buttons respond through colour and focus, without hover elevation.

dos: **Do** keep web reading surfaces white with black structure and yellow emphasis.
**Do** use black text on yellow and keep reading links underlined.
**Do** preserve actual app imagery and the real umbrella artwork.
**Do** keep wide code and tables inside their own scroll boxes.
**Do** retain visible focus and respect reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce green glow, Matrix rain or dark web chrome from the replaced web system.
**Don't** apply web colours to native app screenshots or existing authored films.
**Don't** overlay text on the umbrella or redraw the artwork.
**Don't** add decorative kickers above page or section headings.
**Don't** treat the reference's system display face or hard panel edge as permission to reuse those devices in a different visual world.
